How Hot Should a Sauna Be?

A traditional sauna is usually run between 150 and 195°F, and an infrared sauna between 110 and 150°F. In the long-running Finnish study that linked frequent sauna use with lower rates of fatal heart disease, the average sauna was about 174°F (79°C). Beginners should start at the lower end and keep sessions short.
